brief.question: Should Legion Capital move 40% of its payment volume (about ₹600 crore a month) from Arvanta Payments to Brevis Pay?

options.A: Stay with Arvanta Payments for 100% of volume
options.B: Move 40% of volume to Brevis Pay

constraints: Payment data must be stored and processed only in India
A decision is needed within 2 weeks
No more than one gateway migration this financial year
Overall payment success rate must not fall

criteria.name: Cost
criteria.good_looks_like: Lower total cost after any fixes needed

criteria.name: Security & compliance
criteria.good_looks_like: Meets every data, security and regulatory rule; a blocking finding overrides the score

criteria.name: Reliability
criteria.good_looks_like: No drop in payment success rate or uptime

criteria.name: Growth
criteria.good_looks_like: Unlocks new merchants and products; meets the vendor-concentration OKR

criteria.name: Customer impact
criteria.good_looks_like: Fewer complaints, faster settlements and refunds, lower churn

brief.context: Legion Capital Ltd: Fictional RBI-registered NBFC (digital personal and SME loans) with a merchant checkout product, Legion Pay. All payment volume currently goes through Arvanta Payments; Brevis Pay has run a 2% pilot since August 2026.

routing.routing_query: Legion Capital payment gateway migration 40% volume cost reliability regulation compliance

scores.best_matching_capability: Payment gateway reliability, failover, migration operations
Processing fees, MDR, interchange, transition CAPEX and OPEX
RBI data localisation circulars, card tokenisation, PCI DSS
Vendor contracts, SLA terms, liability and RBI regulation
Merchant checkout conversion, payment options, merchant onboarding
Borrower checkout experience, refund latency, complaint rate

positions.summary: Ops supports 15% phase 1 with dual active routing to verify failover before 40% migration.
conditions: Maintain dual-routing active gateway failover for first 60 days

positions.summary: 18 bps lower blended MDR on Brevis Pay yields ₹1.08 Cr monthly net savings.
Brevis Pay Frankfurt disaster recovery replication violates RBI circular on local payment storage.

blocking_findings.text: Brevis Pay EU backup datacenter lacks RBI India localisation signoff
blocking_findings.fix: Restrict primary and secondary database backups strictly to AWS ap-south-1 Mumbai

positions.summary: Brevis master services agreement requires addendum stipulating Indian jurisdiction for dispute resolution.
conditions: Include mandatory Indian arbitration venue clause in final MSA

positions.summary: Brevis UPI autopay and card checkout improves conversion by estimated 1.4%.

B: Brevis Pay EU backup datacenter lacks RBI India localisation signoff

memo.recommendation: Adopt Option B conditionally with phased rollout starting at 15% volume, subject to InfoSec data residency certification.
conditions: Brevis Pay must certify India-only data storage before volume exceeds 5%
Dual-routing failover must be maintained for 60 days
phased_plan: Phase 1: 15% volume migration with active failover to Arvanta
Phase 2: Expand to 40% volume once RBI localization audit completes

key_numbers.text: Monthly savings of ₹1.08 Cr at 40% volume

blocking_findings.text: Brevis Pay EU backup datacenter lacks RBI India localisation signoff
blocking_findings.fix: Restrict primary and secondary database backups strictly to AWS ap-south-1 Mumbai

dissent: InfoSec: Objects to Option B until RBI data localization is audited and certified.

memo.recommendation: Adopt Option B conditionally with phased rollout starting at 15% volume, subject to InfoSec data residency certification.

human_decisions.reason: Approved with conditions as advised by InfoSec and Ops.
